title: Task Manager
description: Organize your to-do list, manage priorities, and earn Pomodoro coins 🪙 for every completed task!
how_to_play:
1. Add tasks using the input field and set their priority (Low, Medium, High).
2. Click 'Complete Task' when you finish one — you'll earn +1 Pomodoro coin!
3. Use 'Undo' if you accidentally completed a task.
4. Tasks and stats automatically save in your Documents\.mgaio\Saves\Task Manager folder.
5. Check your coin total and keep building productivity streaks!
author: G0ldNe0
